question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Retaliate
solution: The correct answer is '**React**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Retaliate**' is '**React**'. • **Retaliate**: to react to something unpleasant that somebody does to you by doing something unpleasant in return. (किसी के दुर्व्यवहार का जवाब कटु व्‍यवहार से देना, बदले की कार्रवाई करना) • *Example: He insulted people who could be guaranteed to **retaliate** hurtfully.* • **React**: to do or say something because of something that has happened or been said. [प्रतिक्रिया व्‍यक्त करना (कोई क्रिया करना या कुछ कहना)] • *Example: He **reacted** to the news by shouting.* **Correct Answer:__** *React.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Rotate**: to turn in circles round a central point; to make something do this. (धुरी पर घूमना या घुमाना, चक्‍कर लगाना या लगवाना; घूर्णन करना) • **Facilitate**: to make something possible or easier. (किसी बात को संभव या आसान बनाना) • **Clap**: to hit your hands together many times, usually to show that you like something. (ताली बजान) 42:T741, The correct answer is '**answer**'.
